news.title: Major crypto exchanges increase transfer scrutiny with HTX over UK sanctions
news.summary: The UK sanctioned crypto exchange HTX due to alleged ties to Russian sanctions evasion networks and illicit financial activity.

news.title: Banca Sella gets green light to provide crypto services to customers in Italian first
news.summary: The fintech-forward private bank said it is the first Italian lender to get Bank of Italy approval under MiCA to offer digital asset custody and transfers.

news.title: Crypto’s biggest exchanges back push for token disclosure standards as industry courts institutional capital
news.summary: More than 40 crypto firms, including rival exchanges Coinbase and Kraken, are backing a Blockworks-led framework aimed at bringing stock market-style disclosures to token markets.

news.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized assets to Stellar in latest Wall Street blockchain push
news.summary: The U.S. market infrastructure giant targets connecting tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to Stellar in the first half of 2027.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
